records.issue_text: [Low/api] app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:13-15 — `update` ignores params and just re-serializes; it updates nothing. Combined with the client's `saveChanges` calling `embedding.update({})` (admin-embedding.js.es6:5-7, which is dead code — no template invokes it and it has no error handling), the PUT endpoint is a silent no-op that would discard any future embedding-level settings.
records.rationale: The observation is verifiable and accurate: the diff's `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` body is identical to `#show` — it only calls `fetch_embedding` (which just builds an OpenStruct from existing DB rows) and re-serializes, ignoring any request params. Likewise `admin-embedding.js.es6` `saveChanges` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` with an empty payload, and the diff's embedding.hbs template contains only the add-host button plus host rows — no control invoking saveChanges. So no current data-loss defect exists, but the diff ships a PUT route whose handler is structurally a no-op

records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:34 — After save, the client sets `host.category` via `Discourse.Category.findById(categoryId)`. When no category was chosen (categoryId null, e.g., new hosts), the server saves the uncategorized category but the client sets `category` to undefined, leaving the category badge blank/stale until reload.
records.rationale: The diff shows `categoryId: null` as the component default and the save action sets `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` after save, while the server (EmbeddableHostsController#save_host) substitutes the uncategorized category when blank. If no category was chosen, findById(null) would not return the uncategorized category, leaving the UI's category badge stale until reload. The mechanism is grounded in the diff; actual Discourse.Category.findById behavior for null is not fully verifiable here.

records.issue_text: [Low/performance] app/models/embeddable_host.rb:16 + app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:61 — The allowlist check on the public `/embed/comments` endpoint now issues a DB query per request (`where("lower(host) = ?")` — non-sargable and no index exists on `host`), where the previous implementation used a cached site setting.
records.rationale: Verified: migration creates embeddable_hosts with only t.string :host, null: false — no index; EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? calls record_for_host which runs where("lower(host) = ?", host).first, executed on every /embed/comments request via ensure_embeddable in embed_controller.rb. Previously the check used cached SiteSetting embeddable_hosts. The non-sargable lower(host) + missing index + per-request DB query is a specific, decision-relevant performance regression introduced by this diff, though not a correctness defect.

records.issue_text: [Medium/security] db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` interpolates the raw site-setting value directly into SQL. A value containing a quote breaks the migration, and it is a SQL injection vector for the (unvalidated) stored setting. Use a parameterized query or ActiveRecord records.

VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` interpolates the raw `embeddable_hosts` site-setting value (`records.each do |h|`) directly into SQL with no quoting/escaping. A host value containing a single quote would break the INSERT, and the mechanism described (unescaped interpolation of stored setting data into SQL) is verifiable in the diff.
